rationale: protocol/jsonrpc.ts parseJsonRpcMessage(value: unknown) is ParseJSONRPCMessage([]byte) (JSONRPCMessage, error): Go parses bytes and a thrown validation error is the returned error. TestParseJSONRPCMessageMatchesPi compares every recorded Pi result and error against mcp/testdata/upstream-golden.json, produced by mcp/testdata/upstream-oracle.mjs running Pi's function.
protocol/types.ts LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION = "2025-11-25" is the Go constant LatestProtocolVersion with the same value; initialize sends it and the test asserts the negotiated version.

protocol/types.ts SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS (2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05) is the Go slice SupportedProtocolVersions with the same four values in the same order; initialize rejects a server version outside it.
